title: TablesMetadata
description: Metadata file written alongside every tables output directory by paper2table, tablemerge, and tablegather.

reader.description: Identifies which tool produced the output. Extraction runs use the reader name (e.g. 'pdfplumber'), the model identifier (for agent runs), or 'hybrid-<reader>-<model>'. Merge outputs use 'tablemerge'. Gather outputs use 'tablegather'.

uuid.description: UUID v4 assigned to this output.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the output was produced.

source.description: A single input that contributed to this output.

path.description: Path to the source file or directory.

uuid.description: UUID from the source's own metadata, if available.

reader.description: Reader value from the source's own metadata, if available.

gatherSettings.description: tablegather configuration captured at the time of the gather run.

key_columns.description: Columns used to sort gathered rows, or null when none were specified.
